svg.title: Durable Company Analytics lifecycle
svg.desc: The coordinator fixes an execution mode before a run begins and accepts only the first incomplete stage. The caller runtime may do parallel preparation, but commits remain ordered. Each accepted commit creates a durable revision; pause and crash recovery resume from the first incomplete stage, while acknowledged cancellation is terminal. A valid terminal analytics submission enters a recoverable finalizing phase before canonical CompanyAnalyticsResultV1 publication.
